characterizations.result_summary: Confirmed the structure of polymers 1a–1g, and evidenced fast proton exchange in solution and solid phase for polyformamidine 1a.

evidence.source_sentence: The structure of the polymers 1a–1g was confirmed by NMR and titration of the amidine groups.
These cyclic dimers promote fast proton exchange in solution and in the solid phase as evidenced by NMR spectroscopy.
